name: Sansure Biotech Inc.
summary: Sansure Biotech Inc. researches and develops, produces, and sells in vitro diagnostic reagents and instruments in China and internationally. It offers respiratory tract infections, reproductive tract infections, blood-borne infections, gastrointestinal infections, vector-borne diseases and others, DNA/RNA extraction reagents, sample storage reagent, extraction instruments, PCR instruments, mPOCT.
